description: Java class implementing a rule engine node for counting incoming messages over a specified interval and sending telemetry data.

classes.name: TbMsgCountNode
classes.description: A rule engine node that counts incoming messages over a configurable interval and sends telemetry data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration parameters and schedules the first tick message.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages; if it's a tick message, sends telemetry data; otherwise, increments message count.

methods.name: scheduleTickMsg
methods.description: Schedules the next tick message based on the configured interval.
